node.title: Expansion pumping: dense aligned Johnson-neighborhoods over-constrain
node.statement: ASSEMBLY (honest form): combine (a) the anticode toolkit (distance-s independence, combinatorial factors), (b) the same-slope exchange exclusion radius from the residual ledger (t = 2 PROVED in #152 via exchange_calculus; general t = exchange_ledger_gen_t), and (c) the v8 one-support-one-slope cap (PROVED — the q-scale input) into partial B_ap bounds: per-slope alignment sets are distance-excluded and per-locator capped, giving FM-scale bounds on the strata where the exclusion radius is large. HONEST GAP: where the radius is small, closing to FM scale hands off to the energy/inverse pipeline (xr_gvn -> xr_inverse) — the wall's two halves meet here, and the meeting is the wall.
node.attack_surface: rung 1: the toolkit note (classical, S); rung 2: Q4.1's ledger generalization sets the exclusion radius s(t); rung 3: the assembly computation — which strata get FM-scale bounds at which s; the remainder is the pipeline's job, stated without pretense
